demonstrates: A complete describe-then-collect run for the local Field: successful version and revision negotiation, two upserted records, one staged original artifact, one committed checkpoint, and a normal zero exit.
notes: The describe run carries no credential grant and no staging directory. Core commits the cursor only after both records and the artifact are durable.

detail: Core starts the configured executable pinned for field_id 'local_work' with argv 'describe'. No PATH search and no credential grant.

declared_properties.name: local_relative_path
declared_properties.description: Path of the collected file relative to the configured root, retained as display evidence and never used as a path component by core.

declared_properties.name: local_media_type
declared_properties.description: Media type detected for the collected file.

declared_properties.name: local_document_date
declared_properties.description: Document date stated by a text-bearing source document.

declared_properties.name: local_document_flag
declared_properties.description: Source-declared document flag retained as opaque text, never coerced to a boolean.

declared_properties.name: local_tags
declared_properties.description: Deduplicated tags declared by the configured root manifest.

capabilities.description: Generic file collected without modification from the configured root.
Text-bearing source document whose document identity is primary.

collection.refetch_note: The configured root is re-readable, so a lost cursor is recovered by a full snapshot walk.

deletion.note: A completed walk of the configured root is authoritative for absence inside that root and nowhere else.

limitations.message: Archive members are not expanded; an archive is collected as one original file.

detail: Core offered version 1 at revision 0; the Field selected version 1 at revision 0. Negotiated revision is the minimum of the two, so both peers emit only revision-0 members.
Core starts the same pinned executable with argv 'collect' and creates the per-run staging directory it names in the request.

# Rollout reference

Local reference material describing the rollout checklist.

detail: Core resolves handle 'a0001' inside the staging directory only, refuses symlinks and non-regular files, streams the bytes, and computes its own SHA-256 rather than trusting the declared digest.
Core's digest matches the declared digest, so the record is accepted. The original is installed at the A1 content-addressed path derived from core's own digest and the canonical extension registry.
Core assigns the Note ID, sets producer provenance and capture time, computes the normalized body hash, orders keys canonically, derives the UTC filename, and installs the Note atomically.

detail: Second record installed. Its declared prefixed properties 'local_document_date' (date), 'local_document_flag' (text), and 'local_tags' (set-like text list) are typed from the manifest rather than inferred from spelling.
Both covered records and the installed artifact are durable and the store's durability barrier returned, so core atomically replaces the stored cursor for 'local_work'.
Field outcome is complete: two Notes current, one artifact installed, cursor advanced.
